defect.reproducer: Commit b05bb9188db07bd76f83cbf988f5423469fff2b9, branch pr04-defect: frequency validation is skipped. Run python3 -m patrol.patrol and ros2 param set /patrol publish_hz 0.0 in domain 17. The same zero-frequency test fails, and the real node crashes with ZeroDivisionError and exit code 1; no new commands in a fresh 1-second window.
defect.root_cause: Unchecked zero is accepted before the post-set callback cancels the old timer and evaluates 1.0 / publish_hz. Division by zero destroys the running stream.
defect.proof_after: Validation restored before any parameter, timer or active-state change. CLI rejects 0.0; get still returns 5.0. Measured 30 commands in 6 seconds before and after rejection. All 40 tests pass, including the unchanged zero-frequency regression.
